dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open subproblem: conditional superlinear lower bound
dossier_meta.statement_text: An interesting open subproblem is to prove a conditional ``truly superlinear'' lower bound for any of the mentioned problems (map isomorphism, simultaneous conjugation).
dossier_meta.context_text: Some progress has been made: the communication complexity of the simultaneous conjugation problem is $\Omega(dn\log n)$ for $d>1$, and under the decision tree model the search version has lower bound $\Omega(n\log n)$. A conditional lower bound ruling out, e.g., $O(n\,\mathrm{polylog}\,n)$ algorithms remains open.
